memory_materialization_rule: Every social event writes bilateral memory only to explicit speaker/listener. Public or group events expose only statements explicitly spoken in that event. Explicit introductions alone create new weak-tie edges. Exogenous hard-world events are private to named actors until disclosed. Personal state is evidence-grounded and cannot directly write hard-world facts. Consequential behavior defaults to normal unless supplied evidence supports an auditable deviation. Family age alone cannot create health, care, marriage, fertility or conflict events. Storyteller is read-only: chronology is not causality, and narrative interpretations must cite ledger evidence.
